title: Serving Engine Internals — PagedAttention, Continuous Batching, Chunked Prefill

questions.question: 经典静态批处理在处理混合长度请求时的主要问题是什么？
options: It only works with FP4
It cannot use GPUs at all
Padding to the longest prompt and longest output wastes memory and stalls the whole batch on the slowest sequence
It requires NVLink between every GPU

questions.question: PagedAttention 如何将 KV cache 碎片从 60-80% 降低到 4% 以下？
options: By disabling KV cache entirely
By holding the full prompt in CPU RAM
By compressing weights to INT4
通过将 KV cache 分配为固定大小的块（默认 16 个 token），并用每序列的块表进行引用

questions.question: 在 vLLM V1 调度器中，持续批处理的不变式是什么？
options: Each request gets its own dedicated GPU stream
The scheduler waits 10 ms windows to fill a batch before running
The scheduler runs once per request and the batch never changes
调度器每个 decode 迭代运行一次，完成的序列出队，等待的序列入队

questions.question: 分块 prefill 主要保护混合负载下的哪个延迟指标？
options: Mean throughput
Cold-start time
Network RTT
P99 inter-token latency (ITL)

questions.question: vLLM v0.18.0 的功能兼容性矩阵对投机解码与 --enable-chunked-prefill 的组合是怎么标注的？
options: 矩阵将该组合标记为兼容
They cannot be combined in any configuration
Only EAGLE-1 draft heads work with chunked prefill
Only draft-model speculation works with chunked prefill

questions.question: 为什么分块 prefill 本身不会提高平均吞吐？
options: It compresses weights more aggressively
它只减少 decode 时刻的抖动；实际吞吐收益来自在长 prefill 期间保持 decode 序列存活，而不是改变总计算量
It runs on a different GPU than decode
It uses speculative decoding under the hood
